definition.description: Focused regression scope; unchanged typing limits, run count, frames and warmups from the desktop 3D profile. Does not qualify other workloads.

limits: Original 1080p run failed one typing API limit (1.207 ms > 1 ms). It is retained.
After the sample fix, six focused typing runs pass the same four limits with zero audio-setting updates. This is not a repeated full 1080p profile.
4K has not been repeated on this core build.
Allocation savings are proven; unpaired timing runs do not establish a causal speedup or resolve old hover/input failures.
